evidence.abort_reason: search endpoint failed on all of the last 3 ticks
evidence.rollback_error: container 'docker-things-search-1' now has id 1c951d5ba6fb, not the original 1c951d5ba6fb -- refusing to start what may be a different container. Investigate manually (something else may have recreated it).

summary: A kill fault on the things-search service caused a total search endpoint outage (100% error rate) and triggered an automated abort, but the recovery failed due to a container ID mismatch during rollback.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: The kill fault successfully terminated the things-search service, leading to a complete loss of search functionality.
root_cause_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: during_search_error_rate increased from 0.0 to 1.0; search_p95_ms became null.

findings.title: Total Search Service Failure
findings.recommended_fix: Implement high availability for things-search to prevent single-point-of-failure outages.
findings.impact: Users are unable to perform search operations on things.
findings.evidence: during_search_error_rate: 1.0, abort_reason: 'search endpoint failed on all of the last 3 ticks'

findings.title: Automated Rollback Failure due to Container ID Conflict
findings.recommended_fix: Update the chaos tool to handle container recreation or use labels instead of strict ID matching for rollback.
findings.impact: Manual intervention required to restore the environment after a chaos experiment.
findings.evidence: rollback_error: 'container 'docker-things-search-1' now has id 1c951d5ba6fb, not the original 1c951d5ba6fb'

recommended_next_experiment: Test the resilience of the search functionality with multiple replicas of things-search behind a load balancer.
